text: We love this place best Thai in town! We come often, moved here from Bay Area and have been disappointed in the food in Reno but this place is always great!
Excellent food.....much better option than Taco Bell which has been my late night go to ....no more! Open till midnight

NO NO NO 
short staffed
took 30 min to get my first drink
party beside me did  not get their food, it what is a side of macaroni and cheese and it was delivered to several other tables before she finally declined it.
my husband ordered charbroiled oysters  and there was a piece of charbroiled rope in the oysters
waiter assured me it was not hair 
he said only latins cooking 
what?
Then when I went outside to wait for my Uber driver I sat in a broken chair and that they had outside.And I fell to the ground. So this whole experience was awful, my husband didn't think it was the food was bad, but I would never ever ever go here again. and you shouldn't either

My family and I were visiting Santa Barbara from Santa Clarita, Ca and we were in the mood for burgers. We were looking for something different, something unique and we certainly found it at Mesa Burgers. First off the earthy vibe of the interior was cool. Their menu very eclectic. They have raised the bar on different for sure. We had one child with us that insisted on a BLT even though we were in a hamburger place. Management obliged us with a smile and said they would handle it, no problem. That was so appreciated. The hamburgers had real fresh crisp bib lettuce, and beautiful thick sliced tomatoes. You could see the hamburger patty had been free formed and not some frozen *******, and the bun was more like brioche. I had the sweet potatoe fries that were so fresh, it was like that potatoe had just been picked from the garden. My daughter had the herbed and cheese fries and they were without a doubt the best I have ever tasted. We have put this restaurant in our eats in Santa Barbara file and will make it just one of the "fun" things to do while we are in this great beach town.

Mario and Liz were outstanding servers. The food and drinks were amazing, and don't even get me started on the dessert! I was at Roy's for my birthday, and Mario, Liz, and Robert truly took care of me. So thank you to Robert for making my birthday so special!
Food hit the spot for sure. Definitely a big portion too which I like a lot. Also very friendly too. Would highly recommend. This place is awesome!

I recommend Fatma's place. I was checking Yelp for turkish food   and saw the cute place on my way today and found a new stop to treat myself. I had a menemen, Turkish tea and chocolate cake. All was good. They were out of boreks(Turkish pastry similar to Italians laz ani's with parakeet and Turkish feta ). Good food and service. Quick, too.
one of my favorite places to order italian inspired food from! my go to is gnocchi & the antipasto platter. definitely good quality food.

Rainy cold evening...nothing but a good hot Ramen noodle accommodate such evening perfectly. This shop has been on my radar for a while. Finally got a chance to visit. Store was about 2/3 full when visited...lively somewhat but a little dimmed light made inside less lively somewhat for Ramen shop. Sat on the counter...and ordered Pork & Miso and Yaki Gyoza. 
Pork & Miso is basically Tonkotsu Miso soup. Good flavor on soup, but wished a little stronger Tonkotsu as Miso flavor took over. If this is just Miso, it would have been OK. Good texture on Menma (banboo), but Chashu was little tough. I prefer a little more cooked for softer texture on Ramen. Corn and Negi toppings were as expected. Noodle was nicely cooked, medium-thin and curvy with good texture. One wish on Ramen was more selections for veggie toppings, like Sprouts or Cabbage. But overall, this was a good bowl of Ramen. 
Yaki Gyoza was smaller than expected; but it was not prepacked frozen pieces. Skin had good texture and inside filling was meaty and juicy. One point I wonder was some section was "cool" than hot/warm despite just served. I expected hot/warm wherever I bite in...
I understand ordered items and serving process. But I wish they could serve Ramen bowl and Gyoza plate at the same moment than time difference. 
...just another small wish.
Overall, they serve nice Ramen bowl and Gyoza!
I will go back fo

I love how you can go to Shaker Mill for a drink after work and everyone else seems to be doing the same.  There is a 5 o'clock  buzz during the week day that hangs around the bar and tables, and there is a LIVELY weekend buzz when you are looking for a good time!!  Drinks are on par with the vibe and aesthetic of the place: Amazing!

I got an old fashioned and, while I was at I it, jumped over to Cubaneo (in the same space as Shaker Mill) for a sandwich.  My wife and I met here, shared the drink and 2 sandwiches, and the combo was post-work perfection!

Pro tip: order a drink and just walk around the space.  Great interior design and fun old Santa Barbara art work!
Second time going there for some sushi and was very pleased with the food. They make some fantastic roll including fired rolls. Nice crew. Doing what they can to provide a great service

This was my first time in Philadelphia and saw this place on Yelp and had to try it. Got the Jawn and a carrot cake cupcake. Both were amazing but the Jawn was something that really stood out to me. It's cake, cookie dough and frosting. How can you go wrong with that?
Their food is amazing. It is my go-to for Thai food... pad Thai with chicken for me and drunken noodles with chicken for my boyfriend. Delicious every time - cannot go wrong!

This review only applies to vegetarians and the vegetarian items at the restaurant. I had the burrito, wife had the taco salad. Both were fine, but we don't like eggplant and zucchini in Mexican food. The menu didn't mention the eggplant otherwise I would have asked for it to be removed along with the zucchini.

Soooo good!!! The taquitos where super yummy and fresh!! I got them with queso and my friend got them with red sauce.

We also got a cheese enchilada and that was good too, they called it a "flat enchilada" but it was a thick like a Gordita - great flavor to the enchilada sauce.  Chips and queso was yummy too!  Will def be back.
Family run food truck 100 percent worth stopping at to try Tuscons famous Sonoran hot dog. Packed with so much flavor, I could have easily eaten 2 or 3.

***4.5 stars

Decided to try Urban Farmer this weekend to celebrate a birthday and enjoy a "modern" outdoor dining steakhouse experience. We made a reservation, but there were a number of empty tables (which may have been due to the rain that cleared up an hour before we arrived). The outdoor seating had a nice view of the Logan Square garden and fountain!

They've adapted to the times by using a virtual menu that can be accessed with your phone. They have a cocktail menu and a more extensive wine menu available upon request. We decided to split a bottle of the malbec, los medanos. I was pretty underwhelmed by this bottle unfortunately, but there are many other choices. 

For the food, we decided to build our meal around the New York steak tasting ($66) which had 3 6 oz. cuts of distinctive steaks including a leaner steak, a fattier steak, and a dry-aged steak. We loved this way of trying a number of different cuts side by side - we agreed our favorite in the end was the dry-aged steak, but all of them were delicious! In addition, we ordered the baked mac n' cheese, the roasted local mushrooms, and the candied bacon. The mac n' cheese was cheese and delicious. The candied bacon was interesting and not as sweet as I feared, and had an interesting bacon jam on top. The only dish that underwhelmed was the mushrooms which just weren't all that special.

Finally, our waitress was able to honor my request of a surprise birthday sundae with a candle. We were very pleased with the de

We had a great experience At Culver's today! Hubby ordered cod sandwich and I had the single butterburger. I also ordered the onion rings which were delicious! Everything was cooked perfectly and great customer service.

I'm not going to lie, NJ is not my favorite place to visit however Franco's has given me something to look forward to.  I ordered a small pizza(fantastic), fettuccine with white clam sauce(enormous amounts of clams and also fantastic), cannoli's for dessert(sublime), and all was delivered about 15 minutes after I ordered.

Jason
We are in town from California. Just happened to get a pedicure next door. We took a chance on the all you can eat lunch. Great choice!! Great food! Great service!!

This is the best dessert spot. I went here because of the photos and thought it looked cute, when I tried the dessert it was AMAZING!! The salted caramel pretzel ice cream tasted so fresh and it wasn't too salty like some can be, also I believe it has crushed graham crackers on the bottom which went perfectly. The matcha mousse cake was delicious, sometimes I find matcha cakes to have a strange after taste if they used too much but they didn't do that here also it was layered. I will definitely come back, the vibe here it reminded me of Starbucks without the computers. People would come in and just grab coffee and a dessert and sit here and talk it was nice.

This is our favorite local sandwich shop. We tried the Paseo Nuevo location first, but usually end up at the Goleta store when we are in the area shopping. My favorites are the grilled cheese with tomato bisque and the prosciutto and brie, but every sandwich I've tried is excellent. And I'm obsessed with the pickle popcorn!
Took my name and texted me a link and told me to wait and then NEVER contacted me for a table..

My new go-to. I'm super picky being from Southern California when it comes to sushi, but this place has never disappointed me. Love the Angel Roll and the Eel hand roll. Also great outdoor seating atmosphere and fair priced drinks. It can be hard to find parking nearby sometimes, but that's just Broad Ripple.

OMG THEIR RIBS ARE AMAZING!! The melt in your mouth and fall of the bone!! THEIR PULLED PORK SANDWICH IS ALSO TO DIE FOR!!! I highly recommend that you check this place out!!! It is also very reasonably priced

Inattentive staff, confused setup. Friday night and they are OUT OF CHEESE. That is like a Chinese restaurant with no rice. 

 
The place is dead.  A Tampa institution is no more. Pitiful.
Service was great! Got our food in less than 10 minutes! Food tasted really good! The only down part was that the carpet had a really strong odor..

Cash only and they have tried to short us our change twice now. When we say something they laugh and say oh yeah you did give me $40 or $20 and then fork over the remaining $10 they owed us. Are they scamming or just bad at math? Unclear. The food is great though. Just beware.

Food was mediocre compared to a few of the Italian places in Philadelphia. We ordered the octopus (flavor was deliciously refreshing and citrusy, but the octopus was chewy), the tri colored dish which had shrimp asparagus and sun dried tomatoes (the pasta was tougher than usual, like when you undercook pasta) and the squid ink pasta (tomato sauce definitely tastes like it was from the can). We were a bit disappointed in the flavor. With that said, service was good and BYOB is always a plus.

Tonight was the first night of a bocce ball league I'm participating in at blind owl, and so my team and I arrived early for dinner. On the dining room chalkboard were the weeks specials, and so, with the board saying $2 off street tacos, three of us ordered them. All-in-all, the pork tacos weren't great--the flavor just wasn't to my liking--but the steak tacos were delicious and the sole reason this review is not one star. 

When we got our bill, we noticed that the $2 off for the tacos was not reflected and pointed this out. Our waitress said they were not running specials, to which I pointed out the giant chalkboard wall displaying the special. 

She went and talked to the host (possibly manager, unclear) who came over and said he hadn't had time to erase the board. I pointed out that, that could have been done at any time, and that regardless, the board advertised a discount on tacos and that is why we ordered them. He refused to honor the promoted discount. At no point until we questioned the bill did the host, server, or any other staff member (or the menus) mention that the promoted specials were not in effect.

Unfortunately I have to return to participate in my league, but will plan on eating elsewhere beforehand. Very disappointed in the false advertising and dishonesty of this establishment.
The staff here is always awesome! We love to come in for happy hour and sit on the patio. It is very kid friendly and dog friendly too. Can't beat the $3 beers and tacos during happy hour!

First time in and pleased to find out they carry Vegan cheese (Daiya brand). Pizza was good. Everyone else's meals looked flavorful. Live music on Friday night. A bit loud for normal conversation but the singer had a great voice. Will go back again.
Easy parking, modern exterior with great patio sitting, friendly staff and decent iced coffee. Near the airport if you have time before a flight but want to be in the area. No issues.

Probably the best tasting  Pizza in the area. 
The sauce on the Pizza is from another planet and just incredible. Defiantly worth trying

This is our 3rd and most likely the last time to eat here. Service here is the worst Pho restaurant we have experience. Our food order took more than 30 minutes and I ask why and the server said, "thats how it is" realizing its just Pho soup and #35 only. Other customer after us got their food first and they ordered Pho soup too! Their Pho doesn't even taste authentic at all. WORST PHO IN RENO. PERIOD!

I consider myself a sushi snob and I really just can't say enough good things about Ginza. The seaweed salad is huge and so fresh. I love the bento box. I always get an assortment of rolls and every time they are amazing- I always want the same ones but then I forget and get new ones and they are all spectacular. Pennsport is so lucky to have such a great place. Kid friendly! They are so nice in there and the food is ready SO fast!! My husband is obsessed with the ramen, he also loves them all and always forgets which one he liked so he had ended up loving all of them. Thank you Ginza for all the noms!!
Food was delicious!!! The service was great, restaurant was very clean, and workers were very friendly. I cannot wait to go back.

They have vegan pizza(!!) with the absolute best vegan cheese!!! It's not just some sprinkles of Daiya, they use some other brand that is absolutely incredible and perfect for vegans and lactose-intolerant friends! I travel to Brandon for work every so often and every time I'm in town I HAVE to go here! It's a great place for many different dietary choices which makes it great for the friends, family, and colleagues I've met for dinner here! The staff here is also always fun and kind. Love this place!

The restaurant didn't give me  an item on my delivery order. Driver didn't have the item. Restaurants resolution was for me to drive there to pick up the item after arguing about the order being complete.
Poor customer service.

They were quick good customer service and place seemed quite clean

Food was ok not bad not spectacular 

Thought it could use some more spice but the area it is in most don't like too spicy so they catered to the area

$10 plus for the most sorry looking small Italian hoagie (lettuce sandwich) you can imagine. Chewy bread and just a couple slices of meat, ask for "light oil" and instead you get it soaking through the box and the bag. Just awful. Tried them out because Primo's was closed but never again.

Never disappoints. To me this is one of the tastiest seafood restaurants in the city. A lot of the places skimp out on the seasoning but here they hold nothing back! Worth the wait. Worth standing in the line.

Best pizza in Philly!!! If you love thin crust, look no more. This place does it right! Best part is that they do pizza by the slice. The cheese, pepperoni and tomato pie were all excellent! The dough was nice and airy with an amazing crunch. I will only go here to get my pizza fix from now on.

Nice Outside seating area with view of water.  

Attentive waitresses and waiters. 

I ordered Mussels in a creamy beer sauce.   Came with a crusty bread to soak up the broth .   Divine.    

Fairly priced.  Nice bar area.

In reality I'd give this place a 3.5, but I can't so I rounded up. 

Ambience: I really like the layout of the place. It seems new and clean. Plus parking was easy which is always a plus. 

Service: this was the weak point. Our server was nice, but he didn't seem to know much about the menu and tended to describe things in an awkward manner. When asking for item recommendations, "he described a dish as being easy to make." Which I found weird.

Food: the food was solid. Nothing particularly stood out, but I did like the drunken noodles. The curry  was above average, but I did really enjoy the mango with sticky rice. 

Overall: the food was good, but the service left something to be desired. I'm not in a rush to go back, but i wouldn't be opposed to trying it again.

Nice place to get Viet food in west philly. The restaurant itself is quite big so I have never had to wait to be seated. The ambiance of the place is quite nice too. It's a nice walk from Penn's campus when you want to relax and grab some yummy food. 

Every time I have come here, I've gotten the beef pho and spring rolls. Those two items alone are so good that I never got the chance to explore other dishes. Would definitely recommend those two items!

This beautiful restaurant deserves 10 stars . The views of the ocean are magical, the service is impeccable, it embodies old-school style, taste, elegance and courtesy. The staff go above and beyond. I felt like a princess the entire time
If you have not tried Forbici yet, you are missing out. Food and Hospitality top notch. Meatballs, pizza, and pizzas are amazing.

I'm sorry, I asked for a to-go box. Not a catering order! To say that the serving sizes are huge is an understatement! Plenty of food for an awesome price! I had plenty of leftovers the next day which tasted just as good as day served!  
The Mrs and I went a few days ago and let me tell you that I was sad. Sad because I drive by here almost every single day and not once stoped by. That changes today. I had the shredded pork with black beans and white rice. Maduro (plaintains) and an empanada. Mrs. had the beef monfongo. We loved our meal. The pork was moist. I asked for extra sauce drizzled on my rice and really glad I did. The beans were good, could use a extra salt but that might just be me. They do offer some condiments, onions, salt pepper. The empanada was good but not my favorite. I'll have to try the chicken next time. But I'm not saying they were terrible! They were good! 
We walked in and the place was clean, welcomed with smiles and the first thing you see is dessert! Had the flan which I didn't try because Mrs. destroyed it before I could ask. So it's fantastic (so I'm told lol). We will 100% be back to try some more items. But be warned, bring your appetite!

Favorite sandwich shop in Philadelphia (so far). This may be biased since I just moved around the corner but I don't care. This Brewerytown gem lives up to the hype! My first time here I got the Cuban panini and it was incredible. It was very filling so I had to save the rest and it tasted great even as a leftover. My brother got the Kansas City and couldn't stop talking about it. The ambience is casual and cool (I've only been during the day), they always have great music playing. The beer selection is great and I love that they let you put suggestions of what beer to get (Tired Hands Brewery out of Ardmore please!!). The Joes Iced tea is my favorite and the honey Siracha chips were perfect to go along with your sandwich. Overall, my favorite spot in my new neighborhood of Brewerytown!

Girl in drive thru is RUDE ! Asked for dark meat 3 times and got home and no dark meat. Either she wasn't listening because she was rushing people through or she doesn't know her dark meat vs white meat. 

Then in the back of the receipt it asks for customers to take the survey.  The ink is going out on the front and can't even read the information needed to take the survey.

It was my first time here and I thought the food was pretty good. I got the chicken and steak fajitas and they were very tasty. My wife got the Flautas and she said they were great.

The service seemed a little slow and the prices were just a bit high so I gave it a four instead of five. But I come back, yes. Give them a try.

Visited New Orleans for the night and ate here for dinner. SO GOOD!!! I got the company burger w/ bacon, cheesy tots, and a root beer float. All 10/10, and on top of that the staff was very friendly and provided very fast service.

I mean it's okay. But they needed to make clearer indication that their sushi all you can eat is different at lunch and dinner... I ordered some rolls and my fiancée ordered a teriyaki chicken entree his food came out about 15-20 minutes before mine. The restaurant was not at all full but okay it takes time let's not count that i just felt like it was off since I didn't order a huge amount that's all. Water was not refilled at any point. I don't know it was sad because we came back hoping why'd be as good as lunch as they were at dinner which I felt they didn't quite do.. Oh well..
Guadalajara used to be great, but has really gone downhill customer service wise, especially if you're doing any kind of takeout or delivery right now.  Unless you want to wait an hour, stay clear!!
This place has the best coffee and breakfast burritos! Wife and I travels for the first time to Tucson and had this place place twice! Recommend the chorizo platter!!

Food was great... service was not.  Waitress (older Hispanic lady) did not come to our table for a good 10 minutes of us sitting there, looking around seeing if anyone was going to even greet us with "I'll be right with you" nothing we weren't even acknowledged.  Once she finally did come we weren't even introduced with a name just "what can i get you to drink" not even good evening or even a hello.  Once the food came out she did not check on us until basically finished our dishes.  Asked for our bill and waited an extra 15 minutes until we finally got it after flagging her down.  
We will not be returning due to the lack of attentiveness.  If only a manager had come over to ask us how everything was this issue could have been solved.

Ok, I expected more...
The burger was warmed over. Prime sandwich was not good. Servers were on the phones.
Beer was cold. That's good. 
I guess the wings are the only thing I should order here.
Won't try this again...
Such a cool and unique restaurant. Honestly, I'd go back to Philly just for this place. Flavors are beyond amazing and delicious. Service was great and the belly dancing was a fun extra.

Still the best Roast Beef Sandwich in all the area. They hand carve their beef and place it on the roll.  When I order takeout, I usually watch them make my order as I am paying, so you know it's fresh, My go to is extra gravy on the side so I can dip my sandwich. The fries are crispy and delicious. Still have beer specials and the TV's have been updated since my last review.  Closed on Sundays which I still do not get cause they would make a killing but hey they are not hurting for business.

Went to the bar side. The guy working behind the bar didn't even pay attention that I was sitting alone at the table and just sat on his phone. Was really looking forward to checking the place out, won't be going back.

We had a wonderful meal with friends and all of the food and drinks were fabulous!  The service was great as well!  We shared the biscuits, blistered shishito peppers, Crispy brussel sprouts and the Mussels.

Today was my 1st time trying their food and I loved it all! I ordered 2 sushi rolls, steamed dumplings & miso soup to go. Everything tasted fresh and delicious! I'll be back to order other stuff from their menu in the future.
Dive bar vibe with crafty cocktails. Outdoor smoking area and live music within. The crowd was punky hipsters in their mid 30s.
What a great meal ! Pizza and salad were wonderful ! I live in Ofallon mo but will be back for dinner again !
extremely salty. we got a beef soup and chicken bento, i had to throw. inedible, very disappointed

They mess up my orders a lot, so the only redeemable factor is if I feel like returning the drink, they are good about remaking it for me. Most of the time, I just suck it up whether the drink is too bitter (prob. last of the coffee) or too sweet.

I like their latest edition, a Frozen Matcha Latte - it was too sweet the first time I ordered it, even though I asked for a pinch of sugar. Also, I forgot since I purchased my drink on a Fri. - they were running a promotion all month long that included a Free Doughnut; I got a French Curler, which is the only doughnut I eat from Dunkin because I really do prefer Krispy Kremes freshly made ones in comparison.

Dunkin is still running their $2 Iced Latte from 2-5pm all week long, so I mostly order that. Also, don't forget to download the app. to receive points to redeem for a free drink and other specials that includes 2 croissants + bacon for $5.

Great environment. Great food. The carne Asada is bomb! The shrimp is bomb! They have a huge choice of margaritas and cocktails to choose from! I don't know of any other place better, that's in midtown atleast! The owners are very nice as well! I really have nothing bad to say. It was better the second time around too, as well!

Location and parking:  They have an adjacent parking lot so no need to worry about parking. Location is really easy to find, and is the perfect spot because it is just a few miles from downtown.
Food and drinks:  We started off with the biscuit basket because as the name suggests, this place is known for their jams. It comes with biscuits and four jams of your choice. The apple bourbon and the strawberry jalapeno were my favorite. You can also buy their jars for 5-6$. 
Next,  ordered the Tennessee Hot Brown and the blueberry French toast. Both were equally good! The Tennessee hot brown consisted of a biscuit, topped with Nashville hot chicken, gravy, fried egg, all my breakfast dreams in one! Amazing 5 stars. The French toast was unlike any French toast I have ever had, the real winner is the cheesecake batter and the fresh blueberry compote they make in house. It was so dreamy. While initially I thought it would be overly sweet, the blueberries really cut through the sweetness and offer a semi sweet tart aftertaste. 
And don't forget to order the Big Ole Mimosa. It comes in a huge glass and I mean huge , and is made with cider instead of champagne. It was honestly one of the best mimosas I have ever had. 
Service: all I'd like to say here is thank you for your hospitality, Nashville jam café. It honestly felt like we were guests at this lady's home. Also for the recommendations, because there are too many good things on the menu. 
Price:  4.99 for a giant mimosa is really a

I really hate to write this review, and the only reason I'm giving 2 stars instead on 1, is because I've had really great meals there in the past.  We've been going to Sapporo 2 since it opened, have taken many friends, have recommended to others, etc.  It's been a celebratory place for us every few months at least.  Our last visit, around Thanksgiving wasn't great.  The quality had obviously degraded.  But, we went again last night, just to check that the prior visit was a fluke.  It was early and not busy at all.  Only 3 tables.  The nice young man who was our server was obviously new.  As someone who worked in the industry in college, I'm very forgiving about that.  But, the woman "giving him guidance", barely did that, was pretty aggressive with him and it was all pretty uncomfortable to watch.  The sushi chef, the other woman and another man stood behind the sushi bar talking and it took 15 minutes for anyone to notice we'd finished, not gotten water we'd asked for, had empty beers, and had a menu open and were prepared to order more, to maybe give another shot.  We did order a few more pieces just to see, and I will say the egg roe pieces were pretty good.

Now, I'll get to the food.   Wow.  To say that it's declined would be an understatement.  (They had new menus featuring a lot more than sushi, but since that's what we go there for, we weren't interested - if they no longer want to focus on sushi, they should rebrand and take if off the menu).  It was some of the wor

Don't go there for Keto Salad, they  have no clue what they are doing. Four of them could  not figure out how to make a Keto Salad nor did they care. Just a suggestion to Chipotle don't put something on your menu you cannot make!

They have been so bad the passed few years everyone they hire is just so freaking mind blowing , i really feel like they try to hire non smart people , food today was pretty good and the chicka was "okay" even though i honestly truthfully feel like the cook and the chick were hooking up as i rolled through the drive through.  I usually get the 5 rolled tacos for 5 bucks with a soda , cheese & guac .

Good place. I ordered the egg white omelet which tasted fresh, but I could have used some hot sauce and more salt and pepper, so if you order to go be sure to ask for some on the side. The honey white toast was very good, even when eaten dry, but I suspect you aren't coming here for the toast. I had an Italian gray tea which was very refreshing and smooth which would probably have earned this place a fourth star if it wasn't for the slightly steep prices. Solid breakfast.

Atchafalaya is definitely a go-to restaurant every time I'm in New Orleans. 
 Everything is amazing (food and drinks)!  My favorite time to come is for brunch.  I tried the fried green tomatoes, gumbo, pork rinds, buttermilk biscuits, shrimp & grits, and duck hash.  They also have a fabulous Bloody Mary bar in addition to amazing hand-crafted cocktails!  The amazing food, friendly staff plus the live band contribute to the joyful ambiance of the restaurant.  I definitely recommend checking out Atchafalaya.  Be sure to make a reservation in advance because they do book up fast!
Awesome little restaurant in the heart of the Warehouse district!  Clean, country- with an urban vibe.  Rosa our server was sweet and attentive.

What a cute little gem. The biscuits and jams are to die for and their food is delicious. Every time we visit we get way too much food but it's so worth the full belly.  While waiting for your table, there is an adorable area to walk around and shop. Great location.

I'd heard of this local pizza spot for a few months now; was in the area was looking for a quick bite. They offer pizza by the slice and while pies. As soon as he said one of the daily specials was square I was sold!! It was a vegetarian special no matter it was delicious!! One of the better slices of pizza I've had..they are strictly to go now and I'd love to try one of their larger pies next time. If you craving pizza this should definitely be on the list!!

We had Chicken Biryani, Lamb Biryani and Shish Kabab Sandwich. And everything, specially the Biryani was disappointing. It was quiet spicy even though we had asked for mild. Place was weird as outsider (non-Muslim) and specially if you are a woman, we visited during their festival time and there was big male crowd on one table and I stepped in with my family, they kept staring at us like we were some aliens! Weird.  The only reason I give this place one star is because of the owner/the guy at the desk who was very nice and helpful.

This place is a drive thru only! Now that you know this...this place is great! Super quick with great food and great coffee. The food is healthier than your normal breakfast place but still delicious. Owners and workers are super nice. There are 2 chairs for people who walk up but there is no parking for customers because they are in a busy area. Would definitely recommend this place!
Had the gluten free crust!  Delicious. Great modern relaxed atmosphere and decor. Enjoy the vibe.

Great find. Campy and eclectic. Meals are fresh and served quickly.  Coffee selection was good by
If you have to purchase refills
It was good even though service was slow at a very slow time in mid afternoon. I was told they were short handed.

Let me start off by saying that I love Tree House and have had an awesome experience every time I've gone. The owner, the atmosphere, the weekend brunches, the staff, and - of course - the food are all great. 

The chef/owner is always coming up with new and innovative ideas. I like how her travels inspire a new dish, and it often appears on the menu or during one of the multi-course dinners that happen a few times a year (like Valentine's Day, New Year's Day, etc.). 

I like the local tie-ins with wineries and breweries in the area, and the effort to always do something a little on edge, but fun. 

The menu is becoming more and more vegan, which is always a plus in my book. My favorites switch up, but I was always a fan of the vegan beef wellington dish, which took extra time to prepare but was worth every minute! The menu is also seasonal, so make sure to catch your favorites before it changes!

There is an event venue above it, so if someone needs a more private setting with a larger group, they can get the same service up there!

For those that want a finer dining experience, it is a great restaurant for that. My secret hope is that they'd get a downtown location, but I know that depends on a wide variety of things.

Made our way to this restaurant slipping and sliding on the icy sidewalks after calling twice to ensure we could get seating. The guy at the front then tells us they're busy despite empty seating. Too many take out orders so a group of customers that drove in 45 mins here to celebrate a birthday just got left in the cold. We were highly recommending this place due to our past experience here but never again. Especially during COVID. You don't do that kind of sh**.

My complaint drew a wonderful, gracious response from the general manager.  A good apology and a willingness to correct the problem means a lot. Everyone has a bad night. Thanks for being attentive to this customer.

A wide array of foods. I was elated to see crawfish available still. I ordered a pound of spicy and a pound of regular. I also ordered a corn and a pig foot. The crawfish was delicious and spicy as hell they let me sample one. The corn wasn't over cooked or dense at all. It's was perfect. I killed and actually went back to buy more 1 hour later. The pig feet were tender but didn't pick up the flavor or the juice it was sitting it well. But those crawfish gave me life. They were huge and flavorful and PERFECT. They hit the spot and I will definitely be back to try them again as soon as I return to Nola

Another great time and meal at Dolsot. The award winning wings were super as always. The shortribs flavor also awesome. All of the meals were hot and delicious. The "amazing dressing" on the salad was just that, amazing. Make sure you make reservations on the weekend, place is always packed. And don't forget, BYOB!

I could eat here breakfast lunch and dinner morning noon and night every single day give me an IV of their own tab margaritas the three best but I've ever had and needs to be five stars but I'm guessing it's the late night crowd bringing it down never had a bad experience get a firecracker tacos at the Lucy's fire you're welcome
Delicious cafe au lait and great breakfast choices. Friendly staff are an added bonus! My go to spot for breakfast when I am in this part of town!!!

This place was voted Best Breakfast in Reno! So of course I had to try this place! We arrived early before they opened. About ten minutes before 7am, the employees started showing up like clockwork. Even a few more patrons (regulars I'm sure) started showing up in the parking lot waiting for the doors to open. They opened at 7am sharp and we all stormed for the door! Ha ha! Not really! There were only a few of us at open. It did get full by the time we left. While we sat in the parking lot, we browsed the on-line menu and decided on a few things to try. We ordered the Wet Hen Benedict, Vegetable Quiche, and I had to have my Biscuits and Gravy, half order. Everything looked perfect when it arrived at our table. The Benedict was outstanding and full of flavor. The hollandaise made this dish pop! The B&G's sausage gravy was a creamy delight. The biscuit was nice and fluffy. The vegetable quiche was full of roasted red bell pepper flavor. The cheese was nicely broiled on top. I recommend ordering all three! The staff was on top of their game. Our water was always topped off. The servers always asked if there were anything we needed or if everything was OK. This was a five star experience!

This place is amazing. They are clean and the food is honestly delicious. They have Buy one Get one for $1 sushi online and deliver. I definitely recommend it to local Hudson/Spring hill people. Very, very good.

Please help me understand! How is fair to call in advance for a reservation and your being skipped over other patrons? The quality of service recieved is not worth the dine in experience! I do not recommend the restaurant!

Always heard good things about P.F. Chang's  but don't waste your time going to this restaurant. The waiter was horrible never asked us if we wanted something to drink. When she came to our table we asked her about an appetizer after that we placed our order and walked away. We had to wave her down after we received our appetizers by other servers to get waters. When she severed the waters she placed the tray on our table and left it there. After already being annoyed with the service  when my meal came it was uncooked. I couldn't find my server so I finally waived over another server and showed her that my salmon was uncooked. My server came over and was so unprofessional about it. 25 mins after I already ate my boyfriend meal. She brings out a salmon on a plate but with no sides. At that time I told her I didn't want it she gave me a to go container so I was fine with that. She then CHARGED me for the salmon that I didn't even eat. She disappeared again so I finally when up to the host and explained what happened and the host said did a manager come over to the table and I was like no. My server comes up and takes the slip out of my hands and was like I'll get my manger to take it off. She comes back with the fix bill 10 mins later... waiting to get our card back I ran to the bathroom and the hostess stopped me to ask if a manger came over to my table. I told her no and she responded with an oh I'm sorry. 
Yes a manger never came over to apologize to us or did I see a mange

I don't know what Logan's Rachel G was visiting but it couldn't have been this location ‍

3/3/2019 was literally just there and decided to leave this Logan's that I can only guess does not know how to gauge it's weekend volume in regards to there food truck‍. First the waitress was nice as far as I could tell from my short time there. I ordered an app as my meal and my girl ordered ribs after waiting for a table roughly 15 min we waited again for our server after being seated another 10-15 min provided no menu by the hostess so it was a good thing we knew what we wanted as we've been to a Logan's before when visiting my Father in Jacksonville NC (WAY BETTER LOC!) after ordering the waitress came back to let me know they where out of mozzarella sticks ok no worries I'll do wings 2x. I would say not quite 10 min later she came back to let my girl know they where out of ribs‍. I know it's a steak place but dang! ‍‍

Coops was alright.  Nothing great.  Had the rabbit and sausage Jambalaya and the blackened chicken sandwich.  The food wasn't that great but it was reasonably priced and the Abita beers were $4.  Probably wouldn't go back again

Ordered Kung-Pao chicken. Service was friendly and the to-go order was ready within 10 minutes. 

Unless Chinese food is prepared very differently than the same dishes you'd get from virtually any similar restaurant in southern CA, I cannot recommend eating here. There was no heat and no flavor whatsoever, and there wasn't a single red pepper which is the signature ingredient of any Kung-Pao dish. I won't eat here again. But then again....I'm somewhat new to the area and maybe Chinese food in Reno is just exceptionally bland and that's the way every restaurant prepares it.

so this spot used to be the place to go for oversized pizza good comfort food. Since then it has slowly lost its touch. My latest and very last issue I'll be having with this place is ordering a pizza for carryout and it taking only 30 minutes to prepare and I was quoted 45 minutes. So according to the ticket my pizza sat there waiting for ME for 15 minutes. When I call to express my unsatisfaction that should have been guaranteed, I was told I'd be comped the pizza as I was too far away to bring it back and my kids too hungry to care what condition the pizza was in, sad but true. Besides I don't understand restaurants that want you to take the food back that they messed up in the first place so they can give you the right food that they should have gotten right in the first place. So now that's two inconveniences that I deal with. When I called the next night as I told the manager that I would, the manager said I only had a $10 off coupon to use on this next purchase, not another free pizza as she had promised the night before.  So why would I have to eat a shitty expensive pizza that I'm not satisfied with and then when I express my dissatisfaction and disappointment about the professionalism and quality of their product and services...im offered a discount on another product  instead of them trying  to prove to me that they aren't the shady mom and pop that has been around this community for years simply because they put their customers first and not their feelings. Read t

Yummy food, strong drinks, and nice staff! Decently priced for a downtown restaurant. There is an extra charge going on right now due to COVID but they made it very clear. I was able to get seating for 2 around 5pm easily but I image they fill up fast. I definitely want to come back and try their 2-for-1 Tuesday which I hear great things about!
I just found this restaurant and am hooked.  I'm very picky about good, authentic Mexican food.  This restaurant is authentic, and excellent!

Understandable that restaurants are struggling with how to navigate in the time of COVID, but when I place a pick up order at 11:30 am to be scheduled for 6:45 pm, I should not be waiting 3 hours to be told that I won't even be receiving my order. Not only that, but I can't cancel the order either because the online system has marked it as "completed". 

Shame on you for taking advantage of paying customers.

Have you ever had the desire of eating Mexican food inside of a spaceship with submarine decor and loud bass bumping on every single top-40 track that comes on? Well look no further. El Berraco has it all ranging from sea-meat castles to one hundred thousand high resolution big screen televisions showing off all one hundred thousand items on the menu. This IS the millennial pirate paradise. We were given a tablet as we were seated which detailed many of the meat castles in full but alas, I only had room for a fish (or as the menu calls it "fishi") taco. We had been recommended these via a close friend, I won't go into too much more detail on this except that they are 44 years old and my daughter's ex-boyfriend. We don't talk to him anymore. The fish tacos come with about 5 sticks of fried fish with two tortillas. I ordered two and was able to eat all of mine but they were very filling and one would probably have sufficed. My lovely sister had the same as me and she had to take her remaining taco home as leftovers where she'll never eat it and I'll probably end up finding it in the back of the fridge in a week or two and eating it cold.

This was one of my favorite places to come before the shutdown.  It's a cute place with sofas and tables, perfect place for a date or just to hang out and grab drinks with friends.  Can I just say, you HAVE TO get the seasoned french fries.  By far, the best fries I've had, and I am a french fry snob.  Service is friendly and all, too. Right now, they're just doing takeout but I can't wait till everything opens again.
Unbelievably fast, well priced and delicious. Best take out in the area in my opinion. The online ordering and contactless pickup is also a plus

Amazing food, drinks, and atmosphere! The Sushi was delicious and fresh. The service was really great as well even though it was a busy opening night for them. Food and drinks came perry quick. They were also very accommodating. This place will be my new go to!
One of my favorite restaurants in Santa Barbara. Beautiful location by the dog beach, wonderful food, and a great happy hour. A great spot to bring visitors to Santa Barbara.

I just came here for the first time for a to-go order and I'm very satisfied with my order. I had the California Heat tacos (just a little kick), and grilled fish Baja tacos. I will def come here again when I'm craving some seafood tacos. There's other stuff on the menu, but I specifically wanted fish and shrimp tacos.

The worst Pizza and staff not organized. Needs cleaning  and someone in charge that can keep food coming out on time. Waited an hour and a half. Chicken and spinach spoiled on our pizza. Tried charging us full price after apologizing and saying new staff in the back and even manager is in kitchen helping. Didn't pay for pizza but payed for salad because that was decent. We don't usually do these reviews but wanted to share our experience.
Best Chinese in Tampa! I'm very picky with good Chinese and nothing compared this is the best. The make egg drop soup with the right consistency unlike other restaurants around here.

We love this place! Can't wait to try after COVID and sit in. We have ordered twice and the food is fresh and authentic. My 5 year old asks for their pork buns on a weekly basis. Took a star away for having to pay for rice when ordering the Szechuan Beef. But it was delicious!

Farm Burger has one of the best veggie burgers in town paired with delicious and always fresh fries. I always do the build your own with the vegan patty and the farm Burger sauce on the side. The burger falls apart while you're eating it but i take no shame and devouring it in an unladylike fashion. Did I mention how good the fries are? Its also very affordable, my total is never over $11 bucks and I'm always full.

My husband has the occasional craving for Chicago deep dish pizza and was unhappy at the 90-minute wait at another restaurant. Gino's East has the usual 45-minute wait, and it was worth every minute. Crust was perfect and the pie delicious. The thin crust was delicious as well. Loved the pizza bread breadsticks and mozzarella sticks. Would've been better if not out of Old Style. Other options were good.
Mangia Bene Pizzeria  is the original New York Pizza no doubt about it, I had the best Pizza in town and will be a regular. Excellent service and cleanest place I been to in Tampa!

Man, they really hate money here. 
Just walked out with 6 other paying customers because they literally were out of everything except fried rice and maybe 2 entrees and were unwilling to make more because "we close in 15 min". Well last time I checked, that means you're still open.  It's fast food- trust me, I'm more than willing to take my food to go so y'all can go home. (This is on top of the fact that the website says open until 10, I walked in at like 9:12 and they claim they close at 9:30) 
I own a business and would be absolutely livid if my employees told 6 paying customers they couldn't spend money 15 minutes before closing. That's easily $100 they just lost. Good luck staying open with that kind of shit service.

First of all, we had a reservation and we waited almost hour on top of that reservation. ( It will make no difference if you have reservations or not)
After we got our seat, another 45 mins we were seated for server to take our order. Another 45 min to deliver our starter order. We order main course and waited for another 45 min and nothing came. So we decided to leave and the manager came and said your order will be on table in few, we figured our main course order were never added to the system so we left. Felt bad for the manager. 
It was total 3 and half hours for just stater. 
Ridiculous
Fantastic food. The mole enchiladas are enormous and incredibly tasty. I come here often and highly recommend this joint

Hi, yes ordered 2 pollo Asado with tostones. First The presentation was appealing. Upon closer inspection through consuming. First I noticed they put cilantro on it (which is normal) but they had put at least 5-6 inch stem of the cilantro, not really sure why. The TOSTONES NOT FRESH, you could tell they where old and sitting around. (They only take a few minutes to make fresh ? )
Also chicken was on dry side but but very tasty, and the rice and beans had almost no flavor (very dull) . The service from the cashier was NON inviting didn't make us feel welcomed more awkward when ordering.  Thanks.

If you want to dine here you better get here early because there is a huge line, and for good reason. My wife and I mostly share our meals because portions are larger for the most part. We had the Brisket platter with cole slaw and macaroni and cheese. The meat was cooked so well it is easily cut with your fork. The BBQ sauce is homemade and is very good. There is plenty of seating but you still have a wait. When we come back to the Belmont area of Nashville we are definitely stopping here.
Family owned and operated, this is my go-to spot whenever I'm in the Tarpon Springs area. Every bite, pure deliciousness!
We enjoyed a nice breakfast prior to spending our day at the World War II Museum. Nice atmosphere, friendly people, and good food!!

Great service and great food ! The food was home cooked and tasted incredible. The prices are very very affordable. 

It's not the most upscale set up, but it's family run and owned. 

This place is fantastic!

We drove all the way from lower garden to eat here because my bf thinks this place is awesome. From time to time, I let him pick the place, usually breakfast because you really can't mess up breakfast. You know what? This is probably our spot. I want to come back like now. There are two locations - one in Arabi and one in Chalmette. Arabi was a little closer. The place is like a diner. There are a variety of donuts to choose from and specialty donuts as well. There breakfast is pretty spot on, eggs, bacon, toast, biscuit. I got the two eggs with tater tots (YES TATER TOTS, don't @ me), bacon and a biscuit which they ask if you want it grilled (but of course). They have this HUGE coffee machine which makes all sorts of coffee - I like mine iced with white chocolate sauce and milk. He ordered a cinnamon roll to-go and it was as big as my head. Service was fast and nice enough for me to come back!

I've been trying more restaurants for take out during quarantine. We ordered 2 types of sushi, then I asked about sweet potato sushi and they were happy to accommodate. The sushi was great and we've been back again since. 
We will continue to frequent this restaurant and will recommend to everyone!

We come here with my husband's friends, food was delicious so we decided to come back, anddd I should say the second time we order the exact same but the food was ehhh. Actually it was flavorless. 
So that's why Mr. Wok with all my respect  I have to give you 4 starts because you need to keep the same flavor in your dishes to keep us happy
Love this gem of a restaurant. Food is consistently delicious and innovative. Service competes with any 5-Star restaurant-- attentive, not obtrusive and knowledgeable.
Maneee this folks so fucking good!! Real Memphis style cooking.. The greens and rice is the best!!

The drinks are great!  We came here for a drink only but the food looked good too!   Recommend going to Hotel Bar!  Plus atmosphere is cool!
Had the:
 Corpse Reviver No.2- amazing
Moonwalk- amazing

Bf had Clubland- he loved it

Best Thai food in the area! I have been desperately looking for some good Thai since moving to Hendersonville this place is it. I love spicy food and the level 4 definitely hits the spot so far I've had the red curry, the panang curry, cashew chicken, pad Thai, and the Tom yum soup and I've never been disappointed. The employees are kind and it's a great no frills to go experience.

Tables are 6ft apart, take out as well.
This place is soo good and the plates are even Instagram worthy!! Clean restaurant with bar the Micheladas are good as well!! I highly recommend the food has flavor unlike other Mexican restaurants in town. I like their wet burritos and flautas.

I love me some bbq and this was pretty good, we ordered the three meats Brisket, Turkey and Ribs the meat was cooked very good and had plenty of Smokey flavor YUMMY!!! I loved how tender the meat was as well.ok now on to the sides I got Brussel sprouts mac & cheese and  potato salad I loved the Brussels didn't care to much for the Mac  or the potato salad so I'll stick to the bbq  definitely no disappointments there!!

Got take out lunch from DuBu and it was pretty solid! I briefly saw the interior, which looked nice and I could see the staff and patrons were all distanced.
I had the LA Galbi Lunch Special with medium spicy seafood soondubu. I really liked that the soondubu didn't have any really oily or fishy aftertaste and the gal I was tasty and tender. 
I also really liked the side dishes that came in square containers.
It's a bit pricier but the servings are pretty large - if you're not extremely hungry, you can probably share one lunch special between two.

PF Chang's has always l had one of my all-time favorite meals, the beef and broccoli. I also always love the lettuce wraps. Went for dinner tonight on a date after not having been in a while and what a disappointment! First off the lettuce wraps are a small small fraction of the amount you used to get.They serve them in a small container to hide the fact and they are served on top of a bunch of the crunchy noodles so there is even less. The biggest disappointment was the beef and broccoli, it was awful! No flavor and not cooked right. Terrible experience. So much for good memories

Try ALL of their salsas. The service is kind and brings out a basket of chips and assortment of salsas before you order. The portions were large and fitting for the price range: my gf got the chipotle mayo sauce shrimp tacos and I myself got the filete vincentas and both ended up having to take some home. The bill came out to be around $45 for the both of us. Anyway, back to the salsa, the bean salsa was AMAZING. I would go back just for that. They also had different salsas served hot, and an extremely spicy but delicious kind as well.

Every time I come here I'm reminded why I try and avoid it.  This time out of the two orange juices one was filled with ice. Who TF has ice with orange juice? Considering the cup wasn't even full of OJ, I'm assuming they were running out and figured it's just easier to screw a customer.

I don't know why but I'm just not a fan of this coffee shop. I came here to get coffee and study with my friend, and there are just many other places that I prefer to do this at than here. Yes, there are many tables to do work at among other people who are also doing work, but at don't enjoy the vibes. The front is cute but the back of the shop is dingy. 

During my visit, the espresso machine was not working (?!) which is kind of crazy for a coffee shop when a lot of their drinks require this machine. So I couldn't get the latte I wanted, I had to stick to an iced coffee which just isn't my favorite drink. I also got "the works" salad which has chicken and bacon on it. The salad was good overall in my opinion. 

Probably wouldn't return as I have other coffee shops that I prefer over this one.
What happened to the food here ???? They use to bo sooo good now my friends and I don't even go there unless we buying produces

Incredible dinner experience here. The restaurant is super clean and following all safety protocols. The staff was incredibly friendly as well and on it. We even had a nice chat with the owner.

We kicked our meal off with Chang beer. This was a delicious Thai beer and at only $4 a really good deal for drinking out. For our app, we ordered the fresh shrimp spring rolls. These were so good. Very fresh and a great size to split with another person. The accompanying peanut sauce was incredible and I could just eat spoonfuls of it

For our entrees. We ordered the Malaysian street noodles with beef and the red curry with chicken.  Both were incredible and definitely the best we've had in town. I also appreciate the fact that when you order it spicy, they actually prepare it spicy. Both entrees were a generous portion and able to be made into two meals. 

Don't sleep on this spot! Great food at an incredible value with friendly service.

20 minutes and no server. Owner finally took a drink order. Waited 10 more minutes and decided to get dinner somewhere else. 
3rd time here with poor service.
The waitress was incredible! It was our first time there and she brought us samples to try which helped us decide quickly to go with the roast pork! The food was delicious!

My husband was impressed with their catered food at a recent work function. He was anxious to try it so we ordered for Christmas Eve dinner. We were quoted $175 for an antipasto plate, bacon-wrapped jalapeño poppers, chicken Marsala, beef bourginon for 10 people. Picked it up the day before Christmas Eve- was charged $207 for the 3 "food" plates and $25 for 10 poppers and they added a $23 tip! For what?!?! 

The food was quite disappointing. The chicken was tough and dry. The beef was ok. The antipasto plate was pathetic- about 5 pieces of prosciutto, some green pimento olives, pimento pepper strips, artichoke hearts, pieces of bread and lots of cheese. The poppers were on a plate of wilted and slimy lettuce. The poppers were the only tasty thing we had from this place. 

The price was outrageous for the quality. Learned our lesson- we won't give this place another chance.

This place is really just ok. It looks nice but I'm disappointed about spending $70 on bread, bland deviled eggs, cold fries with an ok burger, and pasta where the added meat didn't come out until 5 minutes later on a separate plate. I was expecting more for the premise and prices and probably won't come back.

My friends and I decided to grab some wine after a stressful day at school. This was my first time and my friends have been multiple times so I had high expectations based on their experiences & reviews on here. Wine was amazing. Food was eh. Took 1 hour for a pita pizza and truffle popcorn. Server, Kelly, was at our table maybe 3 times in 1.5 hrs. We had to go ask for our check after sitting for 20 minutes because her friends/regulars showed up at the bar to chat. She had an attitude from the moment we sat down and made us feel like we shouldn't be there/were out of place. Probably the worst service I've experienced for a place that wasn't that busy after the first 30 mins we were there (we got there at 10:30). Disappointed.

Amazing!

Service was outstanding. 

Breakfast was incredible!   Delicious. 

Service was amazing!  Did I say that?

Reasonable prices as well!

Highly recommended!!!

WOW just WOW!!!!! 
My husband and I tried Sushi Inc and fell in LOVE!!!! 
We have had sushi all along the eastern seaboard...and SUSHI Inc is by far the BEST SUSHI we have ever had. 
The restaurant's vibe is inviting and comfortable. The employees are helpful and friendly.  The SUSHI....is AMAZING!!! 
The sushi rolls were so fresh and tasty. The crab rangoons made my eyes roll back. The Tuna Tower was a meal in itself.  WOW....just WOW!!!

This was easily the worst Chinese food I've ever eaten (and I ate less than a third of it.) I asked if they had Japanese beer (I saw later they had 4 brands of Japanese beer) but she said no. Mongolian beef was mostly onions with 1/8"thick beef that was cut in slivers from a 2x4 piece of meat. The rice was crispy from being kept "warm" in tray. Rice wasn't so much crispy as it was dried out. The included spring roll (1/4 roll) was greasy because it was burned by 10:00 am and they let just sit around until 2:00. All of this was served room temperature. The only hot parts of the meal were the blackened (burned) pot stickers.  All in all a travesty of a meal (gag)

Very nice atmosphere and great drinks. Highly recommend for a group night out. They do not do seating at the tables for anything less than two people, but even at the bar was a great experience. Next time I am definitely going to have to bring more people so we can enjoy the outside seating.

GREAT covid regulations put into place. The food is worth the price, but I will say the service is not consistent throughout the week. I have been to lunch  and dinner at Drake's and either they will be annoying or you will see your server 4 times. Overall great place to go with friends or family!!

I went again today and had the Meat Hook burger. Quite possibly the best burger I've ever had and I likes me some burgers. Always fast and quality is top notch. Their fries are crispy and seasoned. Do yourself a favor and get to this place. It's legit!

RUDE RUDE RUDE!!!!!! Waited over an hour to get our food. Was actually yelled at by person running the register because I didn't call ahead. What a way to run a business. You dont treat customers like this. Too many other options for food. We will not be back.
Had such a great night here celebrating my sisters engagement!  Colleen was a fabulous server! Food as always NEVER disappoints.  Can't wait to come back!

Little fish was phenomenal. Ambiance was Intimate, accommodates about 25 guests. Small restaurant feel with an open kitchen, low lighting and communal wine ice bucket for all to share, your elevated neighborhood restaurant. Every step of the dinner experience was the best Philadelphia has to offer. To start, my favorite of tonight was the fresh calamari with jalapeños, Brussel sprouts and peanuts in a delicious sauce. The standout entree was the branzino with long hots, mushrooms and nuts. All of the textures, flavors and quality of these dishes were incredible. Little fish is a must try!
